notes: Hand-set leveling orders (guide-accuracy round 1, owner 2026-11-04). Same schema as ladder-first.json, spent after it (sim/leveling ForSpec). A row here may only change the order of points BETWEEN the levels any sim runs (sim/leveling/ladder_order.go ladderCheckpointLevels: 10, 20, 25, 30, 35, 38, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60), so no band build, golden or published number moves; TestLadderOrderMovesNoCheckpoint enforces it. A row that would move a checkpoint belongs in ladder-first.json, which needs a measured gain.
